output.reason: [ev-fd174730dfa6] says Traefik v3 "no longer supports direct output formats" for Instana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Haystack, Datadog and Elastic, so tracing is now OpenTelemetry-only. The same excerpt, from the v2-to-v3 migration guide, gives two transition strategies: OTLP ingestion endpoints, or OTel collectors with exporters. Operators using those vendor outputs must move to OTel, so migration-required (action) fits, and the proposed statement and remediation match the evidence. The evidence does not say whether old vendor config is ignored or rejected, and it does not state the severity, so I am not changing the kind or the high severity.
